model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the trajectory of model loss across training iterations for six configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with major tick marks placed at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with major tick marks spaced evenly every 0.1 units. All plotted configurations are represented by solid lines without individual markers, and each line is accompanied by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded band of the same color. Every line on the plot exhibits a sharp, nearly vertical decrease from an initial starting value located above the y-axis maximum of 3.4 near iteration 0, before transitioning into a steady, gradual decline throughout the remainder of the x-axis. The solid purple line, denoting "Vanilla," crosses the 3.4 y-axis value early in the plot and steadily declines to a final value of approximately 2.47 at iteration 140000. The solid light blue line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)," crosses the 3.4 threshold slightly further along the x-axis and finishes at roughly 2.62 at the final iteration. The solid orange line, representing "SepLLM (n=64)," descends to conclude the 140000 iterations at approximately 2.53. The solid green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" gradually decreases to end near a loss of 2.51. The solid red line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," decreases continuously to a final value of about 2.49. Lastly, the solid dark blue line, indicating "SepLLM (n=128)," declines over the course of the iterations to finish at approximately 2.51.
